Frequently Asked Questions

How do I apply for Construction & Civil Engineering tenders in Western Cape?

To bid on construction & civil engineering contracts in Western Cape, your enterprise must be registered on the Central Supplier Database (CSD), have a valid tax clearance PIN from SARS, and meet any specific CIDB grading requirements if it involves engineering or construction.

Is CSD registration mandatory for municipal procurement in Western Cape?

Yes, all provincial departments, municipalities, and state-owned enterprises in Western Cape are legally mandated to only source services and goods from suppliers fully registered and compliant on the National Treasury's Central Supplier Database.

How much does it cost to get compliance documents for bidding?

Standard compliance verification starts with a free TenderMatch matrix scan. Key compliance documents like a BEE Affidavit is ZAR 450, a Letter of Good Standing is ZAR 850, and complete CIPC company restoration (if deregistered) is ZAR 9000.
